title: Correction Remediation Execution Gates
principle: Source mutation must happen only through a protected backend execution gate after a commit receipt and a matching execution preview.
public_repo_rule: GitHub Pages may request execution previews and show receipts. It never owns source mutation authority, stores raw content or starts paid routes.

backend_route.purpose: Preview and execute supported remediation commit receipts through backend-only source mutation gates.

ui_contract.auto_preview: commitRemediationAdapter automatically calls previewRemediationExecution when the backend returns a commit receipt

blocked_execution.reason: Knowledge and context repairs stay review-first until collection/source mutation models and rollback routes exist.

scenarios.expected: A recorded remediation commit automatically requests an execution preview.
Supported memory scope repairs can be applied only after execution preview and confirmation.
Knowledge repairs render a blocked execution preview with a clear unsupported reason.
Applied execution receipts expose public-safe before/after metadata and rollback hints.

next.label: Remediation rollback gates
next.reason: Execution receipts now mutate supported memory metadata. The next slice should add protected rollback execution for those receipts.
